result.summary: The page layout appears mostly intact; one minor inconsistency found in favorite icon styling.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline on a dark background, while the same icon on the pizza card below is displayed inside a dark circular background, creating inconsistent styling between similar cards.
